messages:
Mia Chen: Quick runbook draft idea — 1 pager CS can use in handoffs: single health score, top risk drivers, and very short caching/batching/streaming guidance for customers. Keep it non-technical.

Arjun Patel: Agree. Propose 3 signal layers: realtime (stream errors, disconnects), 5m aggregates (failed call % and token throughput), daily snapshot (activation %). Map each to one action.

Sarah Nguyen: Health score needs to be explainable in a renewal call. Small formula we can show: health = round(min(100, 0.4*activation_pct + 0.3*success_pct + 0.2*prefill_pct + 0.1*latency_score_pct)). Interpret: <45 at-risk, 45-69 watch, >=70 healthy.

Rajiv Desai: Short ops playbook bullets: if stream_err_rate > 2% -> open enablement ticket and bump prefill attempts; if prefill_success < 80% -> run targeted prefill with smaller batches and longer window; if latency_95p > 1500ms -> recommend batch tuning (reduce batch_size or increase timeout).

Mia Chen: Customer-facing checklist (one paragraph): what we monitor (latency, prefill success, stream stability), what we do (prefill retries, adaptive batching, graceful streaming fallback), quick wins for you (enable non-personal caching for common prompts, cap max tokens, try smaller batch sizes).

CS Bot: Sample telemetry snippet for embedding in the runbook: {"tenant":"example-inc","health_score":61,"drivers":{"prefill":78,"stream_err_pct":1.2,"latency_95p_ms":980},"ts":1748887777} (put this inline as an example).

Sarah Nguyen: Add feedback capture: 48h follow-up with 3 Qs (prefill improved? Y/N, regressions? text, rate 1-5). Store event to feed next daily snapshot.

Mia Chen: Implementation guidance (super short): Caching — default TTL 24h for template prompts, prefix-based keys, avoid user-personalized cache. Batching — start conservatively (batch_size=8, batch_timeout=40ms), then step to batch_size=16/32 and timeout=100ms while watching tail latency. Streaming — use streaming for interactive UX; on disconnect, replay last stable token window + prefetched context.

Arjun Patel: Failure-mode fallback: on cache-miss storm route traffic to a small dedicated pool or throttle new prefill jobs; include prefill kick command for SRE: prefill-cli start --tenant <tenant> --batch-size 16 --window 2h.

Mia Chen: I'll assemble the page and share for review Thu morning. Short and actionable only.

Rajiv Desai: I'll review SRE bits.

Sarah Nguyen: I'll review customer wording.

Mia Chen: Thanks all.
